content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred).**

Section 2.1 satisfies both preferred MINCOMMIT elements outright — no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and Customer pays only for Services it actually orders, with a decision not to order expressly carved out from breach/shortfall. Section 12.3 (no minimum-volume commitment) and Section 7.1 (no unstated minimum-use charge) reinforce the position, and Sections 4, 7 and 8 contain no take-or-pay, volume floor, or no-downgrade-at-renewal mechanic. No redline proposed.
